summary: Published src/content/blog/beginner/short-heart-line-meaning.md, a focused companion to heart-line.md following the established variation-article pattern (forked/chained/broken-heart-line-meaning). Teaches readers to confirm a heart line is genuinely short before interpreting it, distinguishing length from faintness, breaks, and chaining. Interpretation stays within the bound already established in the heart-line lesson and article: a shorter line may suggest focused emotional investment, not coldness or reduced capacity for feeling. Added one reciprocal link from heart-line.md and updated the canonical docs.
